lines.text: Looks like you can't trust it.
That website looks sketchy, so I'm closing it.

data.mean: Looks like you can't trust it.
data.define: Used for people, places or websites that seem a bit unsafe or fake.

example.text: That website looks sketchy, so I'm closing it.

misuse.text: Don't call your friend's cooking 'sketchy' to her.
misuse.why: It sounds like you distrust it.
